structure.unit: Amendment of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws

law.catch_line: Amendment of bylaws by board of directors or members
law.text:
A corporation's board of directors may amend or repeal the corporation's bylaws except to the extent that:
The articles of incorporation or § 13.1-893 reserves that power exclusively to the members; or
The members in repealing, adopting, or amending a bylaw expressly provide that the board of directors may not amend, repeal, or reinstate that bylaw.
